description: Two figures side by side, each with its own caption directly beneath it -- the scenario the checklist calls out as most at risk of a caption being associated with the wrong figure. This pipeline has no association step at all yet (Picture is never emitted, and nothing links a Caption to a specific Picture region), so this case seeds the minimal geometry for that future check; today it only exercises the same missing-Picture-class gap as the single-figure case.
